category.name: Video editing
category.description: Non-linear desktop video editing, audio mixing, titles, effects, grading and rendered output.
category.audience: Video creators, filmmakers, editors and marketing teams.
category.audienceRationale: Used across industries by people creating edited video; the workflow requires creative production skills rather than serving every employee.

pricing.note: US individual single-app plan; annual commitment, billed monthly; teams and multi-app plans cost more.
US Mac App Store standalone Mac purchase; no recurring billing. This record does not price the iPad edition or optional bundles.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Partial replacement for local timeline editing, effects, audio and grading. Reuse source media; native Premiere projects or Final Cut libraries were not verified as importable. Kdenlive saves MLT-based .kdenlive XML that references media; archive the project to collect media for moving computers. Test representative timelines and rebuild unsupported effects/titles; proprietary project fidelity is unverified.

Partial replacement for local multitrack editing and rendered video delivery. Shotcut saves MLT XML projects and exports video separately; its FAQ suggests DNxHR HQ or ProRes 422 intermediates when accepted by the other tool. EDL export is documented, not native Premiere/Final Cut project import. Rebuild and verify existing timelines; plugin/effect fidelity is unverified.
